literature.title: Long-term effects of selexipag in SSc-associated digital ulcers: a case-control multicentre observational study.
literature.abstract: Digital ulcers (DUs) affect ∼50% of SSc patients, causing significant pain and functional impairment. Current management involves both systemic and local therapies. However, the burden in terms of pain and quality of life due to refractory DUs still remains heavy. While selexipag is approved for SSc-associated pulmonary arterial hypertension, its potential in treating DUs is unexplored. We aimed to evaluate the long-term efficacy of selexipag compared with iloprost in treating DUs.
